narrative.overview: Warm paper, measured rules, restrained typography, and an olive system diagram make technical work legible. The visual language is editorial and practical: generous section spacing gives the content room, while fine borders organize the details. This record follows implemented code rather than an approved visual comp.

rules.name: The Action Rule
rules.body: Keep orange tied to action, emphasis, and interaction feedback; retain olive for the system illustration and process context.

dos: Do preserve the warm paper, olive, and orange relationship.
Do organize services with rules and deliberate columns.
Do retain visible focus, mobile field sizing, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't replace flat editorial rows with floating shadow cards.
Don't present the conceptual diagram as live telemetry.
Don't imply unconfirmed clients, certifications, or partnerships through badges.
